key_quote: The 15 Lean sorrys and unverified Lean-to-Rust gap fundamentally undermine the machine-checkable correctness claim.
rationale: All three reviewers acknowledge the Schützenberger grounding and typed semiring abstraction as novel contributions. The primary blockers are the incomplete Lean formalization (15 sorrys), the unverified Lean-to-Rust compilation gap, STARK proof scope confusion (execution fidelity vs metric correctness), and scaling/coverage limits. These are depth/completeness issues.
